correctness.rationale: The update and independent sampling laws are fully specified. Conditional expansion gives E[z²] and E[zx] exactly in terms of p, s and vartheta. A fixed explicit quadratic energy has signed drift s[vartheta(s+p s²)-2]x²; its 2×2 matrix has leading minor 1+ps>0 and determinant p s²[vartheta(1+ps)²-p]>0 for p>0. Below the boundary telescoping forces sum_k E[x_k²]<infinity; at and above it monotone positive expected energy contradicts mean-square convergence from any nonzero pair. The p=0 degeneracy is treated directly by scalar SGD. Analytic quantifiers, equality, all positive stepsizes and only finite E[A²] are checked. The standalone code independently verifies symbolic identities and 2,800 exact-rational expectation cases; enumeration is supplementary, not a proof of the universal assertion.

originality.rationale: The assessed claim is the evaluated necessary-and-sufficient joint Bernoulli stale-read/independent positive curvature-moment frontier and an explicit synergistic instability witness. Familiar scalar no-delay SGD, deterministic-coefficient stochastic-delay methods, and general lifted second-moment criteria are acknowledged as prior art. Targeted published-finding corpus searches, two relevant published full RESULT texts and the relevant primary full-text models did not give the joint two-moment frontier; the closest 1993 asynchronous-linear-iteration paper is an acknowledged non-decisive full-text access risk.
residual_risks: Beidas–Papavassilopoulos (1993) is plausibly relevant but complete text could not be inspected; older stochastic feedback literature may contain a formulation reducible to the exact two-moment threshold.
Moga–Dubois (1995) image-only report was inspected at selected pages, not exhaustively; its remaining technical sections might contain special formulas.
The exact iid scalar model abstracts away correlations and effects present in real shared-memory implementations.
No independent priority search or independent scientific audit has been performed.

value.rationale: The natural step bound for asynchronous interpolating scalar SGD depends only on a sampled-curvature second moment and Bernoulli stale-read probability, yielding an all-distribution sharp closed curve rather than a conservative sufficient rule. The exact rational witness has stable no-delay stochastic curvature and stable lagged deterministic curvature yet unstable combined dynamics, isolating a mathematically meaningful interaction. The proof supplies an explicit positive quadratic energy usable for further analysis, while limitations to independent iid one-step scalar models are stated plainly; this is not a routine table or normalization observation.
